ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity (yellowish-tan) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous yellowish-tan regions occupy the central-to-distal portions of both lobes; a prominent black vertical column extends from the peduncle to the notch, and a black boundary frames the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to approximately 10% of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased jaggedness and irregular peaks reaching 10-15 pixels in amplitude near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight upward convexity as the trajectory approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (6-8 visible) localized within the high-intensity region of the right lobe; sparse dark spots visible in the upper quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical dark linear disruptions visible near the peduncle attachment and faint horizontal scratch marks on the inner-middle section of the right lobe tan region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue modification and calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on both distal tips; the left tip exhibits significant jagged erosion compared to the right.
other_distinctive_markers: The high-intensity regions display a specific yellowish/ochre pigmentation hue instead of typical white-to-gray transitions.
